title: petasites vulgaris subsp. niveus
intro: Petasites vulgaris subsp. niveus, commonly known as White Butterbur, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of migraines and allergies. The therapeutic actions of White Butterbur include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of White Butterbur include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
